items.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive... and I’m very pleased to have Chuck Israels with me today.

ctx.x: Chuck was interviewed via Zoom on June 11, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m very pleased to have Chuck Israels with me today. Welcome, sir.
Thank you. Glad to be here. Glad somebody’s interested in something for a minute.
